message.content: The purpose of running `llama-server` rather than just a command-line model is to provide a lightweight, OpenAI API compatible, HTTP server for serving LLMs. It’s designed to enable LLM inference with minimal setup and state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of devices. It allows you to launch a local HTTP server with default configuration on port 8080, which can then be accessed via a web UI (http://localhost:8080) and a chat endpoint (http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions). It also supports multiple-users and parallel decoding, and enables speculative decoding.
